title: Machine learning and hypothesis driven optimization of bull semen cryopreservation media.
summary: Prospectively tested cryopreservation media improved post-thaw motility relative to controls. Evidence concerns sampled bovine semen, not demonstrated fertility or generalization to other cell types.
organization: Memorial University of Newfoundland; University of Saskatchewan

evidence.tested: Prospectively tested cryopreservation media improved post-thaw motility relative to controls. Evidence concerns sampled bovine semen, not demonstrated fertility or generalization to other cell types.
evidence.unknown: The date refers to the cited version. Earlier public versions and independent replication were not systematically verified.
evidence.ai_role: Gaussian-process regression with differential evolution is the AI method documented in the editorial source review.
